answer: A doubling admission toll. Each device/IP cluster's first signup burns 1 token; a registry tallies it, and signup n burns 2^(n-1): ten fakes cost 512, twenty cost 524,288, thirty cost 536 million. Weekly audits merge split clusters, and burns never refund. A 1,000-account fleet costs 2^999 — its 60th signup alone outprices every dollar on Earth — while an honest user pays $1 once. Picture an island ferry: the first crossing takes pocket change, every extra boat doubles the fare, and by the tenth the ferryman demands your ivory collection before docking at the inlet.
